package_info.why_malicious: No specific malicious software package or code is described in the provided report. The article is a sector-level threat analysis, discussing attack vectors and threat actor tactics in the retail sector, but does not mention any particular malicious package or code sample.

behavioral_signatures: Automated bot traffic performing credential stuffing, account takeover, and inventory scalping
Phishing emails generated by AI/LLM for initial access
Gift card cracking and fraudulent transaction automation
Web/API scraping for pricing and promotion exploitation
network_indicators: Unusual spikes in login attempts from single IPs or IP ranges
Automated traffic patterns mimicking consumer behavior
Outbound connections to known botnet C2 infrastructure
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor for high-frequency automated requests indicative of bot activity, such as rapid login attempts, gift card balance checks, or inventory purchases. Use behavioral analytics to detect AI-generated phishing emails and credential stuffing attacks. Track for abnormal API usage and scraping patterns. Employ anomaly detection on transaction and login flows, and monitor for third-party vendor access anomalies.
